description: Search every loaded collection (or one, with `collection` = code, bills, opinions, or meetings) and return up to ten results as {id, title, url}. A Code or constitution citation, bill number, or docket in the query comes first. Search matches the words of the document. Ask in the words the document would use, not the words of the question. Pass a result's id to fetch for the document.

collection.description: Search one collection only: code (the Georgia Code and the two constitutions), bills, opinions, or meetings. Omit to search all four.
collection.title: Collection

query.description: Words, a citation (44-7-34), a bill number (HB 136), or a docket (S23A0421). Search matches the words of the document.
query.title: Query

name: search
title: Search all Georgia Commons documents
